_about: ACE register_update template for one project: <ACE Vault>\rules\register.json. The general method is in the tool (revit_guide methods/midp-register-update); this file says where the project's register is and how it is laid out. file: a path or a glob (* in the name) relative to the ACE Vault folder, matching one file. A discipline can override file, headerRow, idColumn, idPattern, stages and dateColumns. stages: the stage name -> the columns that get the submission date. dateColumns: every stage date column (later dates are cleared there); default: every stage's columns.
